'''Ogem''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[near-Human]] [[Ogemite/Legends|Ogemite]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was in the [[D'Aelgoth sector/Legends|D'Aelgoth sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]],<ref name="TEAOC" /> along the [[D'Aelgoth Trade Route]]. It was a busy trade [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TEA" /> that generally avoided involvement in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Politics/Legends|politics]].<ref name="TS" />

Ogemite [[Gender/Legends|males]] tended to become [[Merchant/Legends|traders]]. Very few females became traders, and inheritances passed from father to son unless the family had no male child.<ref name="TS" />

The Ogemites attempted to negotiate trade agreements with the more progressive families of the nearby [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]].<ref name="TEA" /> Ogem shed its political neutrality shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], siding with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] credit became overextended. The Empire retaliated by sending transports full of [[Squill (creature)|squills]] infested with [[Bledsoe's disease]] into the markets.<ref name="TS" />
